description_en: Updates a subtitle template by calling UpdateLiveAISubtitle
name: UpdateLiveAISubtitle

parameters.help_en: The name of the subtitle template. The name can contain only digits, letters, and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with a hyphen
parameters.help_zh: 字幕模板名称，仅支持数字、大小写字母或短横线-，短横线不和位于首位
parameters.name: subtitle_name

parameters.help_en:
The source language. Valid values:
en-US: English
zh-CN: Chinese
ru-RU: Russian
parameters.help_zh:
源语言，取值：
英文：en-US
中文：zh-CN
俄文：ru-RU
parameters.name: src_language

parameters.help_en:
The target language for translation. Valid values:
en-US: English
zh-CN: Chinese
es-ES: Spanish
ru-RU: Russian
parameters.help_zh:
翻译目标语言，取值：
英文：en-US
中文：zh-CN
西班牙文：es-ES
俄文：ru-RU
parameters.name: dst_language

parameters.help_en: The font color. The value is in RGBA format
parameters.name: font_color

parameters.help_en:
The font. Valid values:
KaiTi: KaiTi (default)
AlibabaPuHuiTi-Regular: Alibaba PuHuiTi Regular
AlibabaPuHuiTi-Bold: Alibaba PuHuiTi Bold
AlibabaPuHuiTi-Light: Alibaba PuHuiTi Light
NotoSansHans-Regular: Noto Sans Hans Regular
NotoSansHans-Bold: Noto Sans Hans Bold
NotoSansHans-Light: Noto Sans Hans Light
parameters.help_zh:
字体，取值：
KaiTi-楷体，默认
AlibabaPuHuiTi-Regular-阿里巴巴普惠体-常规
AlibabaPuHuiTi-Bold-阿里巴巴普惠体-粗体
AlibabaPuHuiTi-Light-阿里巴巴普惠体-细体
NotoSansHans-Regular-思源黑体-常规
NotoSansHans-Bold-思源黑体-粗体
NotoSansHans-Light-思源黑体-细体
parameters.name: font_name

parameters.help_en: The background color of the subtitle. The value is in RGBA format
parameters.name: bg_color

parameters.help_en: The position of the subtitle, specified as x and y coordinates with the bottom-left corner of the screen as the origin
parameters.help_zh: 字幕位置信息，以屏幕左下角为起点的 x,y 轴坐标
parameters.name: position_normalized

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display the source language. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否显示源语言，ShowSourceLan默认为false
parameters.name: show_source_lan

parameters.help_en: The number of lines to display
parameters.name: max_lines

parameters.help_en: The number of characters per line. Valid values: integers in the range of [1, 500]
parameters.help_zh: 每行显示字数，取值范围：支持输入【1,500】内的整数
parameters.name: word_per_line

parameters.help_en: The background size of the subtitle. Valid values: [0, 1]
parameters.help_zh: 字幕背景尺寸，取值范围：【0,1】
parameters.name: bg_width_normalized

parameters.help_en: The ID of the subtitle template
parameters.name: subtitle_id

parameters.help_en: The custom description of the subtitle. The description can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and special characters, and cannot exceed 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义字幕描述信息。可包含中英文、数字、字符，不超过128位
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The width of the preview screen. Unit: px
parameters.name: width

parameters.help_en:
The height of the preview screen. Unit: px.

The width × height of the preview screen supports only the following specifications:
Landscape low definition 360P: 640×360
Portrait low definition 360P: 360×640
Landscape standard definition 480P: 854×480
Portrait standard definition 480P: 480×854
Landscape high definition 720P: 1280×720
Portrait high definition 720P: 720×1280
Landscape ultra-high definition 1080P: 1920×1080
Portrait ultra-high definition 1080P: 1080×1920
parameters.help_zh:
预览画面高度，单位：px

预览画面宽度x高度仅支持以下规格：
横屏流畅 360P 640x360
竖屏流畅 360P 360x640
横屏标清 480P 854x480
竖屏标清 480P 480x854
横屏高清 720P 1280x720
竖屏高清 720P 720x1280
横屏超清 1080P 1920x1080
竖屏超清 1080P 1080x1920
parameters.name: height
